title: fix(app-shell): Studio item header's saved-to note says where the customization lives (#30436)
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTL7xvsd9AqyDZgX3C
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuCtrgd3H9uqx7XY1em1jhdt)_

Fixes #30436

## What changes

- `SavedToCustomizationNote` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/savedToCustomization.tsx`) takes a new optional `pairId` prop. Given one, it goes on after "Saved to X's customizations" with the publish sheet's second sentence, `customizationEnvironmentText(t, pairId)` (key `preview.changes.customizationEnvironment`, from #30435): the changes are kept in this environment's database as items of the pair and reach another environment only through `os package export`. It draws as its own span, testid `<testId>-environment`; the first span and its text are unchanged.
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the four call sites (Interfaces item header, Interfaces navigation editor, Data object header, Automations flow header) pass the pair: `customization.pairId`, or `pairIdOf(customization.base)` (the `<base>.custom` id the first save creates) while the base has no pair yet. Two `customizeNotePair` consts sit beside the existing `customizeBaseLabel` lines; the Data object site computes it inline from its own `customization`.
- `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` is not touched. No new i18n key.

## Why

The item header said only where a customization is saved, while the publish sheet also says where it lives and how it moves (ADR-0146 D2). The two now say the same words from the same keys.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run` (from `ui/`) on the four pillar test files and `DraftChangesPanel.test.tsx`: 5 files, 91 tests pass. New assertions check the full English sentence naming `com.example.hotcrm.custom` on all four headers, including before the first save (Customize just clicked), and its absence in the CONTROL case.
- Ablation: with the sentence disabled in the component, 6 of the new assertions fail across the 4 pillar files.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` passes; `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols` passes; eslint on the touched files: 0 errors (pre-existing warnings only).
- `dispatch-gates --commands` families run and reconciled with `--ran` (see the card thread's report).
